parts.text:
Rungs 1 to 4 take a fetched skill. A skill changes the surface (palette, type), not the composition.
Rung 5 is ours. It rejects web page patterns: nav, CTA button, pill, eyebrow, cluttered hero.
Drop the builder rung and the product UI turns into placeholder bars.
